name: Who said it
summary: Anonymous quotes from the Group's own messages or collected lines appear one at a time, and players guess which friend said each.
core_loop: read quote → tap the friend you think said it → see who said it → points
scoring: 1 point per correct, bonus for streaks
social_hooks: compare who knows the Group best
quotes come from what people write for the game
example_prompts: who said it with my friend group's chat quotes
guess which friend said each line
who said it game for our family

name: Whose answer is it
summary: Everyone answers the same prompt privately, then answers are shown anonymously and players match each answer to its author.
core_loop: answer a prompt → answers shuffled → guess the author for each → reveal authors → points
social_hooks: everyone sees how well they know each other
example_prompts: whose answer is it for "worst date idea" with my roommates
anonymous answers and guess who wrote them
guess who wrote what in our group

name: Most likely to vote
summary: A prompt such as who is most likely to oversleep is voted on by the Group, and players earn points for predicting the winner.
core_loop: read prompt → predict who the Group will vote → everyone votes → reveal the tally → points if you predicted
rules: predictors score if the winner matches
scoring: points for matching the Group winner
social_hooks: Group results become a share card
example_prompts: most likely to with my camp friends
who in our group is most likely to get lost game
superlatives game for my roommates

name: Two truths and a lie
summary: A friend enters two true and one false statements about themselves, and the rest guess the lie.
core_loop: friend writes three statements → others read → vote which is the lie → reveal → score
scoring: points for correct lie and for fooling others
example_prompts: two truths and a lie game for my new team
2 truths 1 lie about my summer
two truths and a lie with our group trip

name: Never have I ever tally
summary: Statements about experiences appear, players secretly tap whether they have done it, and the Group sees counts and guesses who did.
core_loop: read statement → secretly tap have or never → see counts → guess who did
example_prompts: never have i ever for a college friend group
never have i ever but wholesome
never have i ever about our trip

name: How well do you know me
aliases: How well do you know me
summary: A creator writes questions about themselves with the right answers, and friends take the quiz to see who knows them best.
core_loop: creator picks answers → friend takes the quiz → each question scored → ranked leaderboard
social_hooks: share your quiz in a Group
example_prompts: a how well do you know me quiz about me
bff quiz for my best friend
quiz my friends about my childhood

name: Rank like your friend would
summary: A friend ranks a short list, such as snacks or vacations, and others try to guess their order.
core_loop: friend ranks items secretly → others drag items into the order they predict → reveal → closeness score
rules: score by distance from true position
social_hooks: friends see how well they predict each other
example_prompts: rank my top five movies guess game
guess how my friend ranks pizza toppings
rank these like my sister would

name: This or that prediction
summary: A friend answers a series of either/or choices, and players predict each of their picks.
core_loop: see two options → tap what your friend picked → reveal → next
social_hooks: see who knows their friend's tastes
example_prompts: this or that game about what my best friend would pick
would you rather predict for my roommates
this or that for coffee orders

name: Favorites matchup
summary: Match each friend to their favorite thing, such as a snack, show or app, from a shuffled set.
core_loop: see friends and items → drag pairs → submit → score
example_prompts: match my friends to their go to snacks
who loves what game
match each friend to their favorite show

name: Whose photo is this
summary: Photos contributed by Group members appear anonymously and players guess who took or is in each.
core_loop: see photo → guess owner → reveal → next
example_prompts: whose photo is it for our trip
guess whose camera roll this is
baby photo guess for my family

name: Baby photo matchup
summary: Members add childhood photos, and players match each baby photo to the current member.
core_loop: see baby photo → pick the member → reveal
example_prompts: baby photo guess for my dorm
guess which baby is who in our family
match childhood photos to friends

name: Friend hot seat trivia
summary: One friend is in the hot seat and the Group answers trivia questions about them, written by the friend or generated from their answers.
core_loop: friend answers prompts → others take a quiz about them → scores → friend sees who knows them
social_hooks: celebrate a birthday with a quiz
example_prompts: birthday quiz about the birthday girl
friend of the week trivia
hot seat game about my sister

name: Fake answer bluff
summary: A true fact about a friend has a blank, players write fake answers, then everyone picks the real one from the mixed list.
core_loop: see a fact with a blank → each writes a fake → all answers shown → pick the real one → points for correct and for fooling
rules: fakes appear with the real answer
scoring: points for the right pick and for each fooled friend
example_prompts: fibbage about my roommates
bluff game with facts about our friend group
make up fake answers for facts about me

name: Mind meld
summary: Two players each secretly pick a word related to a prompt, then try to converge on the same word over rounds.
core_loop: both pick a word → reveal → pick again using both words → repeat until match
example_prompts: mind meld with my best friend
say the same word game
see how in sync we are

name: Predict the Group's percent
summary: A poll question is answered by the Group, and players guess what percentage picked each option.
core_loop: read poll → guess a percent → see actual → score closeness
example_prompts: what percent of our friends would pick pineapple pizza
guess what the Group voted
poll prediction game

name: Who am I clue chain
summary: Clues about a friend appear one at a time, and the player guesses which friend it describes, with more points for fewer clues.
core_loop: see first clue → guess a friend → next clue if wrong → points
rules: clues go from vague to specific
example_prompts: who am I clues about my group
guess the friend from five clues
guess who game for my team

name: Shared memory timeline
summary: Events from the Group's shared history are shuffled, and players put them in the correct order.
core_loop: see event cards → drag into time order → reveal
example_prompts: order our road trip moments
timeline of our friend group
memory lane game for my family

name: Inside joke origin match
aliases: Where did that joke come from
summary: Inside jokes or phrases are matched to their origin stories or the friends involved.
core_loop: see phrase → pick the story or person → reveal
example_prompts: inside joke origin quiz for our group
match phrase to the story
lore of our friend group

name: Compatibility score
summary: Two players answer the same questions separately, and the game scores how often their answers match.
core_loop: both answer → reveal each question → compat percentage
example_prompts: compatibility test with my roommate
how alike are we quiz
friend compat score

name: Guess a number about a friend
summary: Numeric facts about a friend, such as unread messages or countries visited, are estimated and scored by closeness.

example_prompts: guess how many countries my friend visited
friend stats guessing game
how many unread emails does my friend have

name: Spectrum placement
summary: A spectrum between two extremes is shown and players place a friend, or predict where the friend placed themselves.
core_loop: read spectrum → place marker → reveal → distance score
example_prompts: where does my friend fall on introvert and extrovert
spectrum guess game
place each friend on the slider

name: Hot takes agree or disagree
summary: Hot takes are shown and players guess whether a friend agrees or disagrees.
core_loop: read take → predict → reveal → tally
example_prompts: hot takes my friends agree with
guess which takes my sister agrees with
pineapple on pizza hot takes game

name: Where was this taken
summary: Friends' trip photos appear and players guess where they were taken on a map or from options.
core_loop: see photo → guess place → reveal → score
example_prompts: where was this photo taken game from our trip
guess the place from my friend's travel photo
trip recap quiz

name: Whose voice
summary: Short voice clips from the Group play anonymously and players guess the speaker.
core_loop: play clip → guess → reveal
example_prompts: guess whose voice this is
voice note quiz for my friends
guess the speaker from a clip

name: Whose doodle
summary: Members each draw a simple prompt, and players guess whose drawing each is.
core_loop: see drawing → pick the artist → reveal
example_prompts: whose drawing is this game
doodle guess for my class
guess the artist of each doodle

name: Finish my sentence

example_prompts: friend bingo for my new team
find someone who bingo
human bingo for a party

name: Pick the gift
summary: Players pick which gift a friend would most like from a set, then the friend reveals their favorite.
core_loop: see gifts → pick what they would like → reveal
example_prompts: what gift would my friend like quiz

name: Funniest caption pick

funniest caption wins

example_prompts: lie detector with my friend

name: Twenty questions on a friend
summary: Players ask yes or no questions to identify a secret friend, object or memory.

example_prompts: 20 questions with my friend as the secret

name: Who sent this

core_loop: see message → pick sender → reveal

name: Friend fact memory match
summary: Cards flip to match each friend to a fact about them.
core_loop: flip two cards → friend and fact match → keep pair
